scope: Fourteen-day initial-land-water sensitivity smoke with fixed daily checkpoints, fixed declared grey/neutral flux assumptions and finite surface water/energy. Partial380hPa top has explicit exterior solar/LW, not TOA. No observed data, terrain/nonlinear momentum, monthly calibration or adoption.

calendar.kind: Gregorian nonleap day0 January1; physical24h days
calendar.boundary: Fixed simulated representative monthly lateral state; source index retained independently from solar calendar start. Prelude is not assumed to erase initialization.

history_scope: Original per-step history before the checkpoint was not flushed. All original daily fields and budgets are retained; new history contains continuation steps only.
